$comment: Every WGSL file the renderer fetches is linked from src/shaders/<entry>.wesl by scripts/gen-shaders.mjs into public/shaders/<entry>[.<condition>...].wgsl — one file per subset of `conditions`, named in this order (`linkedShaderFile` in src/renderer/shaderFeatureVariants.ts). `fixed` conditions hold for every variant of the entry. Shared helpers live once under lib/ and weather/ and are imported, never copied.
